description: Rejestr Podmiotów Wykonujących Działalność Leczniczą (RPWDL) is published by Ministerstwo Zdrowia. RPWDL registers organisations providing healthcare services. Its stated coverage is Poland; national healthcare-provider register. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Registration does not establish service capacity or real-time availability. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
